bagPolicy.summary: Jazz Fest publishes festival-specific allowed and prohibited items rather than a simple universal bag-size rule. Check the current official FAQ and prohibited-items guidance shortly before attending.
bagPolicy.note: The festival policies are event-specific and can change between editions.

parking.note: On-site parking is very limited and is reserved for eligible VIP packages and a limited number of accessible spaces. Parking in the surrounding neighborhood is restricted to residents.

rideshare.note: The City restricts rideshare pickup and drop-off within a perimeter around the Fair Grounds. Use the current official Jazz Fest transportation map for the designated pickup zone.

concessions.note: Jazz Fest has two major food areas with a wide range of Louisiana cuisine and vegan/vegetarian-friendly options. Food, beverage, craft, and merchandise booths are cashless.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Jazz Fest has a dedicated Access Program and Access Center, accessible routes, viewing accommodations, accessible parking/loading guidance, and services for guests with mobility, vision, hearing, and sensory needs.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: General admission does not include re-entry. Certain qualifying VIP credentials include re-entry privileges at the festival's main gates.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Ticket delivery and event-day support depend on the ticket or package purchased. Follow the instructions from the official Jazz Fest ticket provider and current festival communications.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Public pedestrian access is available at the Gentilly Boulevard, Trafalgar Street, and Sauvage Street gates. Festival gates open at 11 a.m. daily for the currently published schedule; confirm the current edition before arrival.
